name: Gl1tch
pitch: a CORRUPTED slime: its body is sliced into horizontal bands that are shifted sideways like a broken video frame, the face is doubled with an RGB split (cyan copy and magenta copy offset), a black-and-magenta 'missing texture' checker patch on its side, floating voxel cubes breaking off its top, one eye is a loading spinner

name: Doodle
pitch: a slime that looks DRAWN ON PAPER: thick black ink outlines around the body and every part (inverted-hull outline shells, normals flipped, slightly bigger), flat paper-white body with crayon scribble hatching in one colour, a pencil stuck in its head, a cartoon sweat drop and motion lines, simple marker-drawn face: in a 3D world it looks like a sketch come alive

name: Origami
pitch: folded paper crane slime: a crisp faceted low-poly body (flat shaded, visible folds, each facet a slightly different shade of one pastel), sharp folded paper wings and a pointed folded tail and neck tip, a printed washi pattern on one wing, tiny ink-dot eyes and a brush-stroke smile, a paper lantern hanging from the tail

name: Disco
pitch: mirror-ball party slime: body covered in a grid of flat-shaded square mirror tiles (silver with scattered pink, cyan and gold reflection tiles), star-shaped shades, big DJ headphones, floating music notes and light beams, a groovy open grin

name: Skyisle
pitch: the slime IS a tiny floating island: grassy top with a mini tree and a tiny cottage, a waterfall pouring off one edge into a little cloud below, an upside-down rocky bottom with glowing crystals and dangling roots, its face sits on the cliff front, floats above the ground with small rocks orbiting

name: Chrono
pitch: time slime shaped like an hourglass: two goo bulbs joined at a thin waist by a gold frame with posts, golden sand pouring from the top bulb into a pile in the bottom one, clock-face eyes with little hands, a ring of Roman numerals orbiting, brass gears floating around

name: Kitsune
pitch: nine-tailed spirit fox slime: white body with red spirit markings, fox ears, NINE big flowing tails fanned out behind it like a peacock with blue spirit-flame tips, a red fox mask tilted on its head, two blue fox-fire orbs floating beside it, calm confident eyes
